verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships AI features (First Pass AI, GenAI DDQ autofill, the AI Helpbot, and an MCP server), so whether customer data is kept out of model training is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence describes a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use control for AI models. The AI Helpbot transparency article only says the bot answers from approved support content, which does not address training on customer data.
